title: deps: bump flop_phoenix from 0.26.0 to 0.26.3

findings: library_tests_shard failed all six Threadline forwarder tests before dep-off cleanup ran
initial mix ci log showed cached build did not compile Sigra before the failing tests

diagnosis.observed: The first post-fix run still failed all six Sigra.Audit.Forwarders.ThreadlineTest cases. Logs show mix ci did not recompile Sigra before running tests; the subsequent dep-off lane passed and force-compiled Sigra after restoring Threadline. The library job restored _build via a broad legacy restore-key prefix, which could reuse a cache created while the optional forwarder beam was absent.

source_probe.guard: if Code.ensure_compiled(Threadline) == {:module, Threadline} do ... defmodule Sigra.Audit.Forwarders.Threadline ... end
source_probe.finding: The missing attach/1 function is consistent with the guarded forwarder module definition being skipped during compilation.
source_probe.causal_status: The source probe identifies the failure surface but does not isolate why the lockfile resolution changes the compile-time Threadline availability result. No source or CI change is justified yet.

diagnosis.causal_status: Confirmed. The legacy cache prefix restored a build lacking the optional Threadline forwarder before the canonical test suite. Both the cache boundary and dep-off cleanup are fixed and the exact PR ci-gate passed; the merge is awaiting its exact-main gate.

decision: Original #230 cache failure is fixed and merged. #226, #183, and #216 were advanced only after preceding exact-main ci-gates. #216 narrow conflict was resolved by rebasing with current main SDK, preserving Axe 4.13.0, and regenerating package lock; exact-head CI run 36145084408 and ci-gate passed; merged as fed35a4. Await exact-main run 36146050540 required ci-gate. The prior #183 exact-main run 36143764959 required ci-gate passed but its separate admin-eval signal is still running; its final outcome will be recorded independently.
resume_condition: None. The #230 cache failure was repaired and the final Tier B sequence completed through #216; exact-head PR gates and exact-main ci-gate boundaries all passed. Final exact-main full run 36146050540 concluded success. #213 remains reserved for Phase 244.

resolution.root_cause: The canonical library job restored _build from a broad legacy cache prefix and reused a Sigra build missing the conditionally defined Threadline forwarder. Separately, the dep-off lane needed to recompile the whole project after restoring Threadline.
fixes: force compile the whole Sigra project after dep-off restoration
isolate the canonical library test cache under a v2 namespace without restoring from the legacy cache prefix
resolution.note: All six Tier B updates passed exact-head PR gates and exact-main ci-gate boundaries in order. Final exact-main workflow run 36146050540 concluded success on fed35a4, including admin-eval and admin baseline jobs.

install_matrix_failures.cause: Hex registry checksum mismatch against lock for phoenix 1.8.15 during mix deps.get. The next main workflow run after #226 (36141801875) passed all four install-matrix combinations, so the failure appears transient and no code change was made.

additional_main_workflow_diagnostic.admin_eval: The separate admin-eval job failed on 36140299176, then passed on full exact-main runs 36141801875 and 36143764959; treat the original as non-reproducing/transient, with no source change.
